summary: DB2STAT is the shared DB2 Statistics Collector subroutine. Called with a function code, it tracks per-program DB2 activity in a session temporary table: INIT creates the temp table (if absent) and inserts a start row; UPDT stores current row-count/commit/rollback figures; TERM stamps the end time, computes elapsed and (estimated) CPU time, and displays the stats; DISP just displays the current stats. It gives each DB2 program a lightweight self-instrumentation service. SQL failures are reported via ERRPROC.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SELECT CASE function
  WHEN 'INIT': CALL 1000-INITIALIZE
  WHEN 'UPDT': CALL 2000-UPDATE-STATS
  WHEN 'TERM': CALL 3000-TERMINATE
  WHEN 'DISP': CALL 4000-DISPLAY-STATS
  ELSE: SET error; CALL 9000-ERROR-ROUTINE
END SELECT
RETURN (GOBACK)

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
paragraphs.pseudocode:
CLEAR WS-STATS-RECORD; SET program id; capture start timestamp
CALL 1100-CREATE-STATS-TABLE
CALL 1200-INSERT-INITIAL

paragraphs.name: 1100-CREATE-STATS-TABLE
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SQL DECLARE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE SESSION.DBSTATS (columns...) ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS
IF SQLCODE <> 0 AND SQLCODE <> -601 (already exists) THEN SET error 'Error creating stats table'; CALL 9000-ERROR-ROUTINE END IF
branches: IF create failed AND not 'already exists' -> error

annotations.note: SQLCODE -601 (object already exists) is tolerated — the temp table is created once per session, reused thereafter.

paragraphs.name: 1200-INSERT-INITIAL
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SQL INSERT INTO SESSION.DBSTATS (program, start_time, zeroed counters)
IF SQLCODE = 0 THEN rc=0 ELSE SET error 'Error initializing stats'; CALL 9000-ERROR-ROUTINE END IF
branches: IF insert SQLCODE=0 -> ok else error

paragraphs.name: 2000-UPDATE-STATS
paragraphs.pseudocode:
Copy the caller's counters (rows read/inserted/updated/deleted, commits, rollbacks) into host vars
SQL UPDATE SESSION.DBSTATS SET those counters WHERE program_id = :WS-PROGRAM-ID
IF SQLCODE = 0 THEN rc=0 ELSE SET error 'Error updating stats'; CALL 9000-ERROR-ROUTINE END IF
branches: IF update SQLCODE=0 -> ok else error

paragraphs.name: 3000-TERMINATE
paragraphs.pseudocode:
Capture end timestamp
CALL 3100-CALC-TIMES
SQL UPDATE SESSION.DBSTATS SET end_time, cpu_time, elapsed_time WHERE program_id = :WS-PROGRAM-ID
IF SQLCODE = 0 THEN rc=0; CALL 4000-DISPLAY-STATS ELSE SET error 'Error finalizing stats'; CALL 9000-ERROR-ROUTINE END IF
branches: IF final update SQLCODE=0 -> display else error

paragraphs.name: 3100-CALC-TIMES
paragraphs.pseudocode:
COMPUTE WS-ELAPSED-TIME = numeric(end time first 15) - numeric(start time first 15)
SET WS-CPU-TIME = WS-ELAPSED-TIME
MULTIPLY WS-CPU-TIME BY 0.65   -- estimate CPU as 65% of elapsed

annotations.note: SME REVIEW: elapsed time is computed by NUMVAL over the first 15 chars of the timestamp text (a crude numeric subtraction, not real timestamp arithmetic) and CPU time is a flat 65% estimate — both are rough approximations, not measured values.

paragraphs.name: 4000-DISPLAY-STATS
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SQL SELECT the stat columns INTO :WS-STATS-RECORD FROM SESSION.DBSTATS WHERE program_id = :WS-PROGRAM-ID
IF SQLCODE = 0 THEN DISPLAY all stats (rows read/inserted/updated/deleted, commits, rollbacks, CPU, elapsed); rc=0
ELSE SET error 'Error retrieving stats'; CALL 9000-ERROR-ROUTINE END IF
branches: IF select SQLCODE=0 -> display else error

paragraphs.name: 9000-ERROR-ROUTINE
paragraphs.pseudocode: SET ERR-PROGRAM = 'DB2STAT'; SET LS-RETURN-CODE = 12; CALL 'ERRPROC' PASSING ERR-MESSAGE

usage.note: Produced by Claude Code in-session; no API call, no key, no token cost.
